reserveReview.rationale: MCCPA's independent performance attestation report, dated August 11, 2026, examines Brale's assertion as of July 31, 2026 at 11:50 PM Eastern. It records $5,972,459 of cash and cash equivalents and $751,220 of U.S. government-backed debt, totaling $6,723,679 against 6,723,679 SBC issued; the examiner's opinion states the assertion is fairly stated in all material respects. The report describes an AICPA direct examination and says reserve assets are unencumbered and held in accounts segregated from Brale's other accounts, while also disclosing that MCCPA relied on company-provided data and records without independently confirming their authenticity. The complete two-category composition normalizes to 88.827248% cash and 11.172752% U.S. government-backed debt.
